doc: Global feel for every hunter's dash (Shift), applied on top of each kit's own numbers in content/archetypes. dist: multiplier on distance. time: multiplier on duration (speed = dist / time). Owner, Nov 2: dashes were too fast and too far in general, Sparkle's should go further: its lane is drawn from its own numbers, so its distance is raised in content/archetypes/mage.json (4-7m to 5-8.5m) and only its time is scaled here. Dancer (thief) is taken off it: her Cartwheel is the source's measured one (owner review item 7: 4.5m in 0.48s on the ground, 8.4m over 0.95s from a jump), set as-is in content/archetypes/thief.json.
